'"""Visual Python PACF para Power BI; campos requeridos: DATE_TIME y USERS."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.graphics.tsaplots import plot_pacf


def prepare_series(dataset):
    required = {"DATE_TIME", "USERS"}
    missing = required.difference(dataset.columns)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas requeridas: {sorted(missing)}")
    frame = dataset[["DATE_TIME", "USERS"]].copy()
    frame["DATE_TIME"] = pd.to_datetime(frame["DATE_TIME"], errors="raise")
    frame["USERS"] = pd.to_numeric(frame["USERS"], errors="raise")
    if frame["DATE_TIME"].duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError("DATE_TIME duplicado; la serie debe conservar granularidad horaria.")
    if frame["USERS"].isna().any() or not np.isfinite(frame["USERS"].to_numpy(dtype=float)).all():
        raise ValueError("USERS contiene nulos o valores no finitos.")
    series = frame.set_index("DATE_TIME")["USERS"].sort_index().asfreq("h")
    if series.isna().any():
        raise ValueError("Hay horas faltantes en la serie filtrada; PACF no interpola ni rellena datos.")
    if len(series) < 3:
        raise ValueError("Se necesitan al menos tres observaciones para PACF.")
    return series


def render(dataset):
    series = prepare_series(dataset)
    # Mantiene los 72 rezagos del profesor cuando la muestra lo permite.
    lags = min(72, (len(series) - 1) // 2)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.4, 5.2), dpi=125)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("#FFFFFF")
    ax.set_facecolor("#FFFFFF")
    plot_pacf(series, ax=ax, lags=lags, alpha=0.05, method="ywm",
                 vlines_kwargs={"colors": "#1689EF", "linewidth": 1.5})
    ax.set_title("PACF  |  Correlación parcial", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", loc="left", color="#153B60", pad=18)
    ax.set_xlabel("Rezago (horas)", fontsize=10, color="#526B83")
    ax.set_ylabel("Autocorrelación parcial", fontsize=10, color="#526B83")
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#E6EFF8", linewidth=0.7)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#D6E4F0")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#D6E4F0")
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=9, colors="#526B83")
    ax.set_xlim(left=-1, right=lags + 1)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig


if "dataset" in globals():
    fig = render(dataset)
plt.show()
'
